data.narrative:
Neuralink is a private-stage AI & Software company that has raised $1.3B+ to date. The relevant comp universe in AI & Software contains 12 same-sector peers, comprising 1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 identifiable private companies including Scale AI, Figure AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition. However, the peer set lacks sufficient narrow-stage comparables for traditional peer-median valuation: only 1 same-stage peer exists, with 0 adjacent-stage and 0 similar-tier private comps meeting minimum thresholds for reliable triangulation.

The Peer-Median method is inapplicable here due to sample-size constraints. Constructing a valuation on all 12 sector peers would introduce significant methodological error, as that cohort spans disparate funding rounds, market timing, and business models. A full-sector median would not account for Neuralink's specific stage, capital intensity, or regulatory environment.

Given these constraints, the data provided does not support a quantitative valuation range. The analysis would require either: (i) expansion of the comp set to adjacent stages or tiers with disclosed valuations; (ii) application of an alternative method such as discounted cash flow or revenue multiple analysis (data not provided); or (iii) acceptance of a wider, less precise range derived from the public PLTR comparable alone. Material uncertainties include the lack of disclosed current valuation, absence of comparable financial metrics, and limited private-stage precedent in this subsector.
